entries.title: Bounded iid lattice Anderson operator
entries.statement: On l2(Z^d), d>=1, let H0 psi(x)=-sum_j[psi(x+e_j)+psi(x-e_j)] and let V multiply by iid bounded real variables of law mu. The Anderson operator is H_lambda=H0+lambda V, lambda>0. The free band is [-2d,2d], and M=ess sup |V_x| is finite. Centering of mu is an additional assumption, not part of this definition.

entries.title: Draft: coherent iid cubes give common approximate eigenvectors
entries.statement: DRAFT author proof; independent review pending. For the bounded iid lattice model and any fixed m in supp(mu), one probability-one event has arbitrarily distant L-cubes with all |V_x-m|<1/L for every positive integer L. For each E in [-2d,2d], normalized cutoff plane waves on these cubes satisfy ||(H0-E)psi_L||<=2d sqrt(2/L) and ||(V-m)psi_L||<=1/L. Independence is used only for fixed disjoint finite cubes; this asserts no spectral type.

entries.title: Draft: exact iid Born expansion boundary
entries.statement: DRAFT author proof; independent review pending. For bounded iid real lattice disorder with M=ess sup |V_x|>0, almost surely on one event, for all E in [-2d,2d], eta>0, lambda>0 and n>=0, set R0=(H0-E-i eta)^(-1), K=lambda V R0 and c=lambda M/eta. Then ||K^n||=c^n, r(K)=c, and ||R0 K^n||=c^n/eta. The unrenormalized Born resolvent series R0 sum_n(-K)^n converges in operator norm exactly when eta>lambda M, and fails at equality. This does not prove or disprove ac spectrum.

entries.title: False auxiliary bridge: fixed small disorder controls all resolvent heights
entries.statement: This is a FALSE auxiliary assertion, recorded to prevent its use: for centered bounded nonzero iid lattice disorder, sufficiently small fixed lambda makes the unrenormalized Born resolvent series converge in operator norm at every eta>0 for energies in the free band. The draft exact-threshold result refutes it at eta<=lambda ess sup |V_x|. Its refutation does not refute the Anderson delocalization conjecture or renormalized methods.

entries.title: Anderson spectral delocalization and GOE statistics are separate obligations
entries.statement: Scope note from C0056: existence of nonzero infinite-volume absolutely continuous spectral weight and periodic finite-volume GOE bulk statistics are different assertions. A proof of one supplies no proof of the other without an additional theorem. The w486 Born-threshold proof is an auxiliary route obstruction and proves neither assertion. Current openness was UNKNOWN at the 2026-10-10 check because an unverified recent primary manuscript claimed the uniform-law spectral assertion; no novelty claim is made.

relations.rationale: The coherent-cube statement explicitly requires the model's iid site law and nearest-neighbor hopping.
The necessity proof uses cube-supported vectors jointly approximating H0 energy E and an extremal V value m.
For every fixed lambda>0, eta<=lambda M gives Born terms whose norms do not vanish, contradicting the asserted convergence at every positive height.
The scope note records exactly which C0056 obligations the route obstruction leaves open.
